checks.name: the daemon starts and builds a macOS image (image create --macos, the IPSW cache seeded by APFS clone)
sandbox create from the macOS image boots; shell exec -- sw_vers says macOS 27
desktop screenshot is a real frame (not blank) with no window-picker prompt, then and for 15 s after
with the Apple menu open, desktop screenshot still captures (one SCStream frame) and shows the menu
browser open https://example.com, then a desktop screenshot shows the page, and browser screenshot answers
sandbox sleep hibernates it; sandbox start restores it and a process started before is still running
image create --from the running macOS sandbox saves it (sync-only freeze), the stall reported, and it keeps running
a second sandbox from the captured image boots with the file, a different machine identifier and its own identity
a third macOS sandbox, with two running and idle, sleeps the least recently used one; never more than two macOS VMs run
with both running sandboxes busy, waking the third answers machine_full with macOS's limit as the reason, not a Virtualization error
once mac-two is idle again, waking mac-one sleeps mac-two and restores mac-one from the state it was slept with
everything the probe made is removed: sandboxes, the captured image, the base
